column1: # Talk to the weaponsmith from a seeded save standing south of the counter.
# The seed was re-written by `reseed.py` on 2026-09-10. The previous one was
# copied from a run profile and predated the NPC-band writer, so it reached
# DOSBox with that region zero - and `conversation.md` Section 2 says what
# that does: "A save written by another program that leaves that region zero
# makes every NPC in the location answer `No response!` until the location is
# re-entered from outside - that is a property of the save, not of the game."
# The stock side duly answered `No response!` to every Talk, and this scenario
# compared nothing. With a populated band it matches the engine on all three
# beats. Nothing about the engine changed.
# requires-seed: the party standing south of the weaponsmith's counter
